title: Derivative in the scale of a radial cutoff integral
statement: Let n and l be natural numbers, mu a measure on R^(n+l), y in R^(n+l), and f : R^(n+l) -> R mu-integrable on the closed ball B_S(y). Let phi : R -> R be C^1 with phi(u) = 0 for all u >= T, where T > 0, and let t > 0 with T t < S. Write r_x := |x - y| and phi' := deriv phi; all integrals are Bochner integrals over R^(n+l). Then s -> integral phi(r_x/s) f(x) dmu has derivative -(integral (r_x/t) phi'(r_x/t) f(x) dmu)/t at t.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) (y : Amb n ℓ) (f : Amb n ℓ → ℝ) (φ : ℝ → ℝ) (S T t : ℝ), IntegrableOn f (closedBall y S) μ → ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → 0 < T → (∀ u : ℝ, T ≤ u → φ u = 0) → 0 < t → T * t < S → HasDerivAt (fun s => ∫ x, φ (‖x - y‖ / s) * f x ∂μ) (-(∫ x, ‖x - y‖ / t * deriv φ (‖x - y‖ / t) * f x ∂μ) / t) t
